articles.title: Exclusive: Elizabeth Warren Warns Banks Against Lending $20 Billion to Argentina
articles.content: Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D., Mass.) told the biggest banks in the country not to finance a $20 billion loan to Argentina, citing the financial risk the facility would pose both to depositors and U.S. taxpayers. Warren sent letters to JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Citigroup and Goldman Sachs saying that a $20 billion loan to President Javier Milei’s government “would raise serious safety and soundness concerns…given the shaky creditworthiness of Argentina and its apparent lack of valuable collateral.” The banks have been seeking details from the Treasury Department on how they can be sure they will get their funds back, The Wall Street Journal reported.
